description: Experience true 5-star comfort in this spacious 130 sqm fully air-conditioned luxury residence in the heart of Le Marais / Haut Marais. Redesigned in 2025, it blends Parisian elegance with modern refinement, featuring Versailles parquet, curated artwork, and noble materials. Located in a secure building with coded entry and elevator, it offers rare privacy and tranquility in central Paris. Ideal for families and discerning travelers.The spaceThe spacious open living and dining area is made for meaningful moments together. Whether you’re sharing dinner, celebrating, or simply unwinding after a day in the city, the space invites you to gather comfortably. Enjoy seating for up to 10 guests around a large dining table, surrounded by custom-made furnishings and original artwork by a renowned contemporary painter. A living space of this scale is exceptionally rare in central Paris, offering both elegance and room to truly breathe.Bedrooms – A True 5-stars Sleep ExperienceAll four bedrooms are thoughtfully arranged on one level for effortless comfort. You’ll enjoy three king-size beds with luxurious 35 cm hotel-quality mattresses, plus one cozy 140 cm bedroom. One king can be converted into two singles upon request. A large queen-size sofa bed in the living room provides additional flexibility. Each room features blackout curtains, double-glazed windows for peaceful nights, Smart TV (Netflix ready), a dedicated workspace, and custom wardrobes. The apartment is fully air-conditioned, with high-speed fiber WiFi throughout.Kitchen – Made for Real LivingThe fully equipped independent kitchen is designed for those who truly enjoy cooking.
